<!-- thm-1: body_md -->
\label{thm}
There exists an efficiently constructed sequence of rational approximations of $G$ with exponent index $\kappa\geq 0.62$. More explicitly, there exists an efficiently constructed sequence of rational numbers $\widetilde{p}_n/\widetilde{q}_n$ ($\widetilde{p}_n,\widetilde{q}_n\in {\mathbb Z}, \widetilde{q}_n>0$) with
\[
0<\vert G-\widetilde{p}_n/\widetilde{q}_n\vert \leq 1/\widetilde{q}_n^{\, 0.62}
\]
for all sufficiently large $n$.
<!-- end thm-1 -->
